fields.description: 8-byte game identity signature at the start of the header block; load path compares all 8 bytes against the mirror copy and re-initializes the save if they differ.
fields.evidence: FUN_080101c4 compares DAT_0801024c[0..8] against DAT_08010250 (8-byte loop) after FUN_0801031c loads the header via FUN_08002868(0,0x40,...); baseline holds 'MetalGun'.
fields.name: game_identifier

fields.description: Fixed validation tag immediately after the identifier; the save is accepted only when this word equals 0x6b ('k'), and init writes 'k' plus three zero bytes.
fields.evidence: FUN_080101c4 requires *(int *)(DAT_0801024c + 8) == 0x6b; same function init writes pcVar1[8] = 'k' with pcVar1[9..0xb] = 0. Baseline file offset 0x10 = 0x6b.
fields.name: save_revision_tag

fields.description: First word of a paired 16-bit meter defaulting to 150; written by header init, covered by the header checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_080101c4 header init writes pcVar1[0x32] = -0x6a (150); RAM buffer byte X maps to file offset 8+X, so buffer+0x32 is file offset 0x3a. Baseline holds 150.
fields.name: meter_current

fields.description: Second word of a paired 16-bit meter defaulting to 150; written by header init, covered by the header checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_080101c4 header init writes pcVar1[0x34] = -0x6a (150); RAM buffer byte X maps to file offset 8+X, so buffer+0x34 is file offset 0x3c. Baseline holds 150.
fields.name: meter_maximum

fields.description: Single counter byte defaulting to 1; written by header init, covered by the header checksum. Exact gameplay role unconfirmed.
fields.evidence: FUN_080101c4 header init writes pcVar1[0x36] = 1; RAM buffer byte X maps to file offset 8+X, so buffer+0x36 is file offset 0x3e. Baseline holds 1.
fields.name: play_counter

fields.description: Zero-filled reserved span between the revision tag and the meter pair; covered by the header checksum, all zeros in the live baseline.
fields.evidence: Span lies inside the FUN_08002868 / FUN_0800299c header range (file offsets 8..72) and is left zero by the FUN_080101c4 init path; baseline bytes 0x14..0x39 are all 0x00.
fields.name: reserved_padding

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'MetalGun' identity signature verified by FUN_080101c4
